items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: I knew him, yeah. He was a drummer. He was. Oh, yeah. He was good.

ctx.x: Good evening. Go back there and answer the moister. I was going to ask, we have a couple more minutes here before we finish up. Yeah, yeah. If there's any of the old time drummers you can remember, that you were, when you were a boy or just younger, that influenced you or that you liked in particular, I say for instance, old man Cottrell or some of those.
Old man Cottrell, yeah. Never knew of them. I knew him, yeah. He was a drummer. He was. Oh, yeah. He was good. But he used to play with Peter Buckeye now. Yeah. The Creole Cernet.
